title: I used AI to build a reddit game – looking for feedback
author: SmoothAardvark65

comments.author: AgenticGameDev
comments.body: Tons of physical glitches.  The gif is AI generated which brigns up the expectations and then I was let down by real game play. Structural and actual implementation-wise I think it's quite good but graphically and so on it's not that good. It was also confusing about that it auto fires. Probably should state that somewhere because I was trying to figure out which button fires......

replies.author: SmoothAardvark65
replies.body:
Thanks for the detailed feedback! Really appreciate you trying the game.
Good point about the auto-fire — I should probably make that clearer. I’ll also keep working on the physics and visuals.

comments.author: Odd_Walk9282
comments.body: I think it's a pretty fun game, just a couple glitches. Granny can walk through buildings. Overall, it's pretty fun to play. I think you could add a tutorial, though.

replies.author: SmoothAardvark65
replies.body:
Thanks for playing and for the suggestions! The tutorial is actually already done and will be added once the update passes review.  
Walking through some buildings is intentional — I wanted the game to feel a bit more casual and less restrictive.

comments.author: MrMe1111
comments.body: Was wave 47 and was laggy from wave 10 and game crashed at 47. Nice game and till you fiquere out the lag u dont need so much units as thats were the lag come from

replies.author: SmoothAardvark65
replies.body:
Wow, wave 47 is insane — I honestly didn’t imagine anyone would reach that far!
I’m really sorry about the crash. I’ve run into the same issue during testing as well.

In the latest test build I’ve already made some optimizations: enemies no longer grow infinitely in number. After reaching a certain amount, instead of spawning more, their stats increase. I also changed the gold drops so they don’t stack endlessly above enemies anymore. This has improved the lag a bit, but it’s not fully solved yet.

I’ll keep working on more optimizations today and see what else I can improve.

By the way, may I ask if you were playing on a computer or a phone?

Thanks again for playing and for pushing the game that far — I really appreciate the support. I’ll keep improving it!

replies.author: SmoothAardvark65
replies.body: Hey, I just pushed an update. Could you please have a try? Hopefully, it can fix the issue. Thanks!
